brief: Prioritise this ageing unit for pre-event attention before the forecast heat event, as units of advanced age with high loading histories have reduced margins against mechanical failure under thermal cycling [MG-023]. If an outstanding vegetation or obstruction defect is present, execute clearance work in preference to other remedial activity to restore the unit's cooling margin [SOP-011]. Where blocked ventilation louvres are identified, clear any obstruction exceeding one quarter of the free area before the heat event [SOP-015].
